title: Craftable Golden Heads
description: Brings the UHC Golden Heads to your server, fully customizable
body:
### Features - Customizable Item Name, Lore, Texture, Custom Model Data - Customizable Consume sound - Customizable Permissions - Customizable Messages - Placeholders - Customizable given effects - Permissions for every action
- MiniMessage
- Togglable Player Head Drop
- Togglable Consume Cooldown
### Commands /goldenhead reload
/goldenhead give
### Placeholders
%goldenhead_cooldown% ![Commands](https://i.imgur.com/5Yz3ewf.png) ![Recipe](https://i.imgur.com/r9jZNNK.png)
config.yml ``` item: material: "PLAYER_HEAD" name: "ɢᴏʟᴅᴇɴ ʜᴇᴀᴅ" lore: - "" - "Right click to absorb its power." # Base64 texture string used only when the material supports custom heads. texture: "eyJ0ZXh0dXJlcyI6eyJTS0lOIjp7InVybCI6Imh0dHA6Ly90ZXh0dXJlcy5taW5lY3JhZnQubmV0L3RleHR1cmUvMWU1YmY2MDM2Mzg2YjJlYjAwZmMyZTYzNWU1NzViNzRlMmI1YTBjNjljYmI1MzY5MWFlZGZkYjZhMGMzNjAwOSJ9fX0=" custom-model-data: 0 give-effects: - type: REGENERATION duration: 200 amplifier: 1 ambient: false particles: true - type: ABSORPTION duration: 2400 amplifier: 0 ambient: false particles: true cooldown: enabled: true seconds: 30 permissions: use: "goldenhead.use" craft: "goldenhead.craft" drop: "goldenhead.drop" admin: "goldenhead.admin" cooldown-bypass: "goldenhead.cooldown.bypass" messages: prefix: "[GoldenHead] " cooldown-active: "You must wait s before using it again." no-permission: "You do not have permission." reload-complete: "Configuration reloaded." crafting-blocked: "You cannot craft this item." command-usage: "Usage: /goldenhead reload|give [amount]" command-unknown: "Unknown subcommand." player-not-found: "Player is not online." give-usage: "Usage: /goldenhead give [amount]" head-drop: enabled: false require-permission: false drop-rate: 1.0 # 1 is 100% placeholder: cooldown: format: "s" ready: "0s" ```
